summary.summary:
Migrated pydantic_cli from pydantic 1 to pydantic 2 API (all 35 tests pass on pydantic 2.14.3).

Library (pydantic_cli/__init__.py):
- Removed pydantic.fields.ModelField usage. _add_pydantic_field_to_parser now takes a FieldInfo. New helper __split_field_annotation derives the v1 equivalents (inner type_, allow_none, list/set shape) from FieldInfo.annotation.
- field.required -> field.is_required(); field.default maps PydanticUndefined to None (v1 semantics); field.field_info.description/extra -> field.description/json_schema_extra.
- cls.__fields__ -> cls.model_fields; cls.schema() -> cls.model_json_schema(); cls.validate() -> cls.model_validate(); cli_config.copy() -> model_copy().

Core (pydantic_cli/core.py):
- CliConfig uses model_config = ConfigDict(validate_default=True, validate_assignment=True) instead of class Config.
- _get_cli_config_from_model tolerates models without an inner Config class (v2 no longer provides a default).

Examples:
- Field(cli=...) -> Field(json_schema_extra={"cli": ...}) everywhere.
- CastAbleEnum: __get_validators__ -> __get_pydantic_core_schema__ (before-validator wrapping the enum schema).
- ExampleConfigDefaults: allow_mutation=False -> frozen=True.
- simple_with_boolean_custom: outfile and gamma (Optional without default) now set `= None` explicitly. In v2 an Optional field without default is required, so this keeps the example's CLI contract.

Dependencies:
- REQUIREMENTS.txt: pydantic >= 2.0, < 3.
- setup.py: python_requires >= 3.8 (typing.get_origin/get_args, pydantic 2 minimum); removed 3.7 classifier.
- No companion packages (web frameworks/plugins) are pinned in this repo.

Behavior note for users: in pydantic 2 a field annotated Optional[T] with no default is required, so the CLI now requires such options unless the model gives them an explicit default (e.g. `= None`). Under pydantic 1 they were optional.
